name: @abbey/client
description: The Drowned Abbey client: a chain library (keys, signing, commit-reveal, verification) and a terminal UI

scripts.build:proto: pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/lib/proto.js ../plugin/proto/*.proto && sed -i.bak 's|^import \* as \$protobuf from "protobufjs/minimal";|import $protobuf from "protobufjs/minimal.js";|' src/lib/proto.js && rm src/lib/proto.js.bak
